variants.instructions: Decide whether this SMS is a scam. Look for pressure to act fast, links to unknown sites, requests for money, gift cards, codes or bank details, and senders that cannot be checked. A real message may still sound serious or contain a link from a known sender.

criteria.true: A scam or phishing text meant to steal money or personal data (fake delivery fees, fake bank alerts, gift-card requests, fake jobs, fake refunds).
criteria.false: A real text from a known person or business, such as a receipt, code, reminder or genuine fraud alert that asks you to use official channels.
